scope_note: The party's weekly organ, issue of 26 April 2015 (archived Last-Modified 29 April 2015), recorded as a raw Internet Archive capture of 29 April 2015. A report of the 21st Congress at Visakhapatnam (14-19 April 2015) and of its concluding public meeting on 19 April 2015; the days are printed in its text.

rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: People's Democracy reports that the open session of the 21st Congress 'began in the morning on April 14' and that 'Prakash Karat, general secretary of the CPI(M) inaugurated the Congress'.

rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: The report says 'The new Central Committee, Control Commission, Polit Bureau and general secretary were elected by the Congress on April 19'.

rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: Reporting the public meeting that concluded the Congress 'in the afternoon, on April 19', People's Democracy calls him 'Prakash Karat, the outgoing general secretary', addressing the meeting.

locator.item: public meeting paragraph beginning 'Prakash Karat'; section 'Arise in Struggle', last paragraph for the April 19 date

rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: At the same public meeting of 19 April 2015, the report says, the 'Newly elected general secretary, Sitaram Yechury, addressing the gathering called upon the people to come and support the CPI(M)'.

locator.item: public meeting paragraph beginning 'Newly elected general secretary'; section 'Arise in Struggle', last paragraph for the April 19 date
